decisions.reason: The Flat Plan structures the issue but does not change the required visual style or brand alignment.
Providing the Flat Plan guides issue assembly but does not alter the independent obligation to create a magazine template.
The Flat Plan does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The issue-structure reference does not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The Flat Plan does not change the requirement for each article to include the author's name and photo.
The Flat Plan does not change the required circular shape or small size of author photos.
The layout reference does not change the required interactive PDF flipbook deliverable.
The Flat Plan does not resume or otherwise change the deferred print-ready output requirement.
